in_marathi.name: Barun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of rain, god of monsoon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Barun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Barun is the god of rain, monsoon, and cloud. He is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati and is also known as Mahadeva or Kubera. Barun is believed to bring the monsoon rains that are essential for agriculture in India.
